nodes.label: ADR 0012: Dev Sandbox Topology and v1 Launch Currency
nodes.rationale: Single Avantej Stripe account with four named sandboxes: default-test (manual exploration), dev-shared (all engineers + preview deploys), ci-e2e (GitHub Actions), staging (pre-prod). Per-dev sandboxes rejected (5-cap doesn't scale). v1 ships USD-only. Schema-forward: every monetary table carries currency text column from day one. Amounts in integer minor units (cents). Application-fee math uses integer arithmetic only.
